launches.title: RealRoots 👯‍♀️ the IRL friendship app for women
launches.tagline: Real friends, made in real life.
launches.body:
**TL;DR - Answer a few questions, and we’ll match you with new friends IRL for in-person experiences. Friendship guaranteed.**

THE PROBLEM:

Making friends as an adult is hard. Women lose half of their friends every 7 years, and yet there is no easy way to rebuild those circles. This fundamental problem has led to ⅔ of Americans regularly feeling lonely to no fault of their own.

THE SOLUTION:

We know that friendships form when three ingredients align: 1) compatibility, 2) repeat encounters, and 3) authentic conversations. That’s why we designed RealRoots to reliably deliver all three, allowing us to guarantee friendships.

* **Friendship compatibility:** We ask women a questions about her life stage and values, matching with with compatible new friends in her area
* **Repeat Encounters:** When a woman joins RealRoots, she commits to meeting her friend matches for multiple shared experiences, allowing enough repetition for connection to develop.
* **Authentic Conversations**: RealRoots experiences are led by a trained facilitator, who guides deep conversations and icebreakers so that a woman gets to know her matches intentionally.
* A woman joins for a quarter, a year, or longer.

 

WHY WE’RE BUILDING THIS:

We’re building the product we desperately wished existed. After moving 10 times between us, we’ve repeatedly felt the struggle of rebuilding a community from scratch, and the isolation that follows. We created RealRoots because we want to solve this problem, for ourselves and for every woman seeking genuine connection.

OUR ASK:

**Meet friend matches (women only):** Have any female loved ones who are looking for female community? Spread the word about RealRoots. And if you’re a woman, we’d love to help you [meet your new local friend group](https://www.therealroots.com/).
